## Reproduce the Supporting Information

From the repository root, run:

```sh
Rscript code/run_all.R
```

This runs the main analyses followed by Supporting Information. The supplementary scripts use the same prepared data as the main results and build missing inputs on first use. Tables are saved in `output/tables/si/` and figures in `output/figures/si/`.

*Release note: Supporting Information currently includes S1 and S2. The remaining sections will be added in subsequent updates.*
